content.content:
Bent-Spine: "A merchant drowned in the deep water just south of the trapdoor you came down. His lockbox of pledges lies locked on the floor, where he went down. A pledge is a thing a client left with him against a loan. Three of his clients wait on the south bank of the deep water for a diver, and each says one thing in the box is theirs. I want the box emptied before they find one. Dive down, open it and take what is inside. What becomes of what you take is yours to say. I will not tell you whom to give it to. The Chapter takes from those who can bear the loss, and these pledges are other people's. Whoever holds them can sell them back, or can sell silence about them. Blackmail is no trade of ours, and I will not have a Lookout of mine in it. The lock is a Novice lock. Here are three lockpicks. Go up through the trapdoor, and the deep water lies just south of it."

- Tilts-The-Jug, who keeps the Night-Reed Chapter's desk, gave me three lockpicks to see how I work. Keeps-What-Floats, a dock thief west of her door, took a sleeping Lookout's necklace of blue jaspers and keeps it in a strongbox under the eaves north-west of the house. I'm to take it back without harming him; Sits-By-The-Water knows his habits.
- I took the Blue Jasper Necklace out of Keeps-What-Floats's strongbox. I'm to bring it to Tilts-The-Jug inside the house on Soulrest's dock, behind the door beside S'Tabi.
- I gave Tilts-The-Jug the Blue Jasper Necklace, and because Keeps-What-Floats came to no harm, she paid me a hundred gold. I'm to take the coast ship from Soulrest's dock to Lilmoth, go down the trapdoor north of Pusbottom at the edge of the deep water and speak to Bent-Spine.
- I went down through the trapdoor north of Pusbottom to the Night-Reed Chapter under Lilmoth, and Bent-Spine, the Chapter's fence, took me in as a Lookout. Tilts-The-Jug had set me to take a stolen necklace back from Keeps-What-Floats without harming him, and what became of him is now part of how she and the Chapter think of me.
== The Drowned Lockbox (completed)
- Bent-Spine, the Night-Reed Chapter's fence, has work for me now that I am a Lookout. I'm to ask him about it, in the Night-Reed Chapter under Lilmoth, down the trapdoor north of Pusbottom.
- Bent-Spine told me a merchant drowned in the deep water south of the trapdoor north of Pusbottom, and his lockbox of pledges lies on the floor. He wants it emptied before its three clients on the south bank find a diver, and gave me three lockpicks. I'm to dive to the lockbox, pick its lock and take what is inside.
- In the drowned merchant's lockbox were a worn bone figurine, a Neesak charm in new silver and Kothringi glass beads. Neeta-Haj, Okan-Tei and Dar-Zeel on the south bank each claim one, and each claim is a lie. - Neeta-Haj said the bone figurine was carved for her clutch, but it is worn smooth, far older than any clutch of hers.
